title: Docs: add Quickstart templates landing + RAG/agents walkthroughs + observability setup
author: Wei Chen
body:
## Summary
Adds the docs-site pages for the Quickstart templates launch (RAG, Agents, and Combined). Includes end-to-end walkthroughs, safe defaults + troubleshooting notes, and a dedicated Observability Setup page that matches the telemetry contract v1 and the Console dashboards.

This PR is intended to be the canonical entry point from the product nav and the in-repo READMEs.

## Why
We’re seeing consistent onboarding drop-off after “API key works” when users try to assemble a production-shaped example (timeouts/retries, correlation IDs, 429 behavior, and missing telemetry). The templates already include safe defaults; the docs need to (a) explain the contract, (b) show minimal copy/paste that matches the repos, and (c) set expectations on Hosted vs Dedicated/Private.

## What’s included
- New landing page: “Quickstart templates” with a ‘choose your template’ decision table
- Walkthrough: RAG (Python/FastAPI)
  - ingestion pipeline + query endpoint
  - vector store backend notes + extension interface
  - caching defaults + timeouts/retries pointers
- Walkthrough: Agents (TypeScript)
  - tool allow-list pattern, tool timeouts, JSON schema validation
  - streaming UX notes (proxy considerations)
  - safe error handling / partial failure behavior
- Observability setup page
  - request_id + tenant correlation pattern
  - required trace attributes + recommended spans
  - metrics emitted (latency, token usage, 429/5xx/timeouts)
  - “How to see it in Console” screenshots + deep-link hints
- Dedicated/Private section (lightweight)
  - what changes (networking, auth, retention)
  - where to start (link to Dedicated/Private guides) + explicit non-goals
- Troubleshooting section (first wave issues)
  - 401/403 misconfig, 429 backoff, streaming disconnects, CORS on local dev

## Safety / compliance notes (docs-only)
- Adds explicit language: “Do not log prompts/responses by default; treat them as potentially sensitive.”
- Adds PII handling guidance consistent with template defaults (redaction note; opt-in sampling for debug).
- Clarifies tool-calling safety: allow-list by name + schema validation + timeouts and error isolation.

## Checks / launch criteria
- [x] Snippets are sourced from redwood-quickstarts (no drift)
- [x] Telemetry names/attrs match the v1 contract
- [x] Link-check is clean
- [x] Pages build with search index generation

## Follow-ups (not blocking)
- Add a short “deploy to managed env in <60 min” guide (k8s + terraform examples) once ENG-2851 docs are ready
- Add a glossary for error taxonomy once support patterns stabilize

Refs: ENG-2850 (Docs-site integration), ENG-2852 (Cost/latency instrumentation examples), PM-412 (Launch gate)

Screenshots: intentionally minimal; we rely on Console deep-link sections and keep images stable for translation/reflow.
commits: docs(quickstarts): add templates landing page and nav entry
docs(rag): add python RAG walkthrough (ingest + query) and config section
docs(agents): add TS agents walkthrough with tool safety patterns
docs(observability): add telemetry contract mapping + Console setup instructions
docs(troubleshooting): add 429/streaming/CORS FAQ and common misconfig fixes
chore(docs): snippet extraction wiring + lint fixes for INT-811
review_conversation:
Elliot Price (review): The landing page reads well, but the first section should explicitly call out the <15 min goal and that these are “production-shaped” (timeouts/retries/telemetry). Also, the nav label should be “Quickstart templates” (plural) to match release notes.

Wei Chen (author): Updated intro to include time-to-first-success target + moved the production checklist callout above the fold. Nav label updated.

Monica Patel (review): On the Agents page, the streaming retry guidance needs to match the SDK helper defaults (we don’t want people implementing reconnect loops incorrectly). Please link to the SDK recommendations page and avoid pseudocode that suggests retrying mid-stream.

Wei Chen (author): Removed the mid-stream retry suggestion; replaced with “retry on initial connect” guidance + link to SDK recommendations. Added note about idempotency keys for non-streaming.

Logan Wright (review): Observability page: a few attribute names are off. We need `request.id`, `tenant.id`, `model`, `route`, and `redwood.deployment` exactly (cardinality controlled). Also please add a short warning about putting raw prompts in span attributes.

Wei Chen (author): Fixed attribute names to match contract v1. Added explicit guidance: do not attach prompt/response content to spans/metrics; use opt-in debug logs with redaction.

Naomi Feldman (review): PII wording: make it unambiguous that prompts/responses may contain regulated data and should be treated as sensitive. Also add a note that `.env` files must not be committed and recommend secret managers for anything beyond local dev.

Wei Chen (author): Tightened PII language and added a “secrets” callout box referencing the template local-dev policy; emphasized `.env` in `.gitignore` + secret scanning.

Kira Thompson (review): Dedicated/Private section is good, but please avoid implying feature parity for audit logs/retention. Suggest: “availability depends on your deployment mode and retention settings.”

Wei Chen (author): Updated wording to be mode-agnostic and pointed to Dedicated/Private guides for retention/audit configuration.

Elliot Price (final): LGTM after link-check rerun. Please squash and merge before launch branch cut.

Wei Chen: Squashed and merged.
